name: runninghub

settings.title: RunningHub

tools.name: runninghub.search
tools.description: Search the RunningHub standard-model registry by words and output type (image, video, audio, 3d).

tools.name: runninghub.schema
tools.description: Return one RunningHub model: endpoint, output type and parameter schema. Do not invent fields.
